description: This file defines the NotesDatabase class which manages CRUD operations for notes in a local SQLite database in a Flutter/Dart application. It includes methods to initialize the database, query, insert, update, delete notes, and close the database connection.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: A singleton class that provides methods to interact with the notes database, including initialization, querying, inserting, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: initDb
methods.description: Initializes the database if it hasn't been initialized yet.

methods.name: _initDatabase
methods.description: Creates or opens the database and defines the schema for the notes table.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database, setting creation and update timestamps.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note, refreshing the update timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
